origin: Independently written bounded reservation workload based on the stale-sale-count pattern of Yogar EX1 airline-25.i. Six agents and capacity five, one mutex protecting accesses, protected post-join exact-fill contract rather than the upstream upper bound.
thread_bound: Exactly six agents, each makes one request; main creates all six and joins all six.
property: After all agents finish, five seats have been sold.
assumptions: Zero initial sales, six requests and capacity five; all agents complete one reservation attempt.
intent: Hold the booking mutex continuously across the read, capacity test and conditional write.
